name: intro-body
zh: 会议发言者的位置与次序不断变化，固定指向设备需要反复调整。SoundSight首先服务会议发言者指向，后续面向机器人等具身智能设备，提供声源方向感知与说话人身份信息。
en: As people move and take turns speaking in meetings, fixed-direction devices need re-aiming. SoundSight targets meeting applications, with future use in robotics and embodied AI for sound direction and speaker identity.

name: system-scope
zh: 系统以Zynq-7020实现声音感知与指向控制。PL承担同步采集、频域相关和双轴PWM，PS执行三维求解、声纹验证与跟随决策；最终设计通过RGB触摸屏完成本地操作，并以方向引导定向拾音。
en: Zynq-7020 combines sound sensing and pointing. PL handles synchronous capture, frequency-domain correlation and pan–tilt PWM; PS handles 3D estimation, speaker verification and tracking. The final design adds local RGB touch control and direction-guided audio.

name: technical-heading
zh: 关键技术问题与设计要点：
en: Key technical challenges and design choices

name: technical-body
zh:
空间测角：非共面四麦提供水平与垂直约束，
输出方位角和俯仰角，不估计距离。
任务协同：定位持续更新，声纹异步计算，
通过结果在有限时间内参与跟随决策。
执行控制：方向质量、范围和模式共同决定
动作，默认不开轴，保留停止与超时保护。
功能接合：拾音接收同步音频与有效方向，
触摸交互贯通配置与状态反馈。
en:
3D direction: Non-coplanar mics constrain azimuth and elevation; no distance estimate.
Scheduling: Direction updates continue during speaker scoring. Passing results grant a timed permit.
Motion: Direction quality, limits and mode gate motion. Axes default off, with stop and timeout guards.
Integration: Directional audio uses PCM and direction; touch links settings and status.

name: tetra-heading
zh: 正四面体四麦三维测角

name: tetra-description
zh: 正四面体四麦的非共面布局形成六组时差约束。PL提取通道间相关特征，PS通过亚采样插值、最小二乘求解和方向筛选，计算声源方位角与俯仰角。阵列几何、求解程序与软硬件处理链路共同构成三维测角方案，为双轴指向和定向拾音提供方向输入。
en: Four non-coplanar, tetrahedral mics provide six time-delay constraints. PL extracts correlation features; PS uses subsample interpolation, least squares and filtering to estimate azimuth and elevation, guiding pan–tilt aiming and directional audio.

name: async-description
zh: 声纹异步计算，通过后在限时内允许双轴按新方向更新，避免动作逐次等待推理。许可作用于当前声源方向，尚不保证多人身份与方向绑定。
en: A passing score grants a timed permit, so pan–tilt updates need not await each inference. This uses the current direction without guaranteed multi-speaker identity binding.

name: joint-heading
zh: 定位、声纹与双轴联合运行
en:
Joint localization, verification
and pan–tilt operation

name: test-conditions
zh:
48 kHz采样；方向筛选窗3帧，至少1帧合格；
音量门限12000（PCM统计量）。
en:
48 kHz; direction window: 3 frames, at least 1 valid.
Level threshold: 12000 (PCM statistic).

name: joint-result
zh: 两轮板端试验均完成了定位读取、声纹评分和双轴目标提交，运行期间故障值均为0；用户现场观察到机构随声音方向转动。结果支持三类任务在同一平台联合运行，提交次数仅表示控制命令，不代表机械到位。
en: Both board trials combined localization reads, speaker scoring and pan–tilt commands with runtime fault values of 0. The user observed turning toward sound. This supports joint operation on one platform; commands do not confirm that the mechanism reached each target.

name: test-limitations
zh: 测试采用同一目标模板，声纹试验门限为0.45、许可时长为10 s，两轴同时启用。两轮停止前各完成6次声纹计算，方向通路在其间持续更新。第二轮淘汰1个旧定位结果；当前证据尚不能给出角度误差、身份识别准确率或长期稳定性结论。
en: Both axes were enabled. The trials used one target template, threshold 0.45 and a 10 s permit. Each run completed 6 speaker evaluations before STOP as direction updates continued. Run 2 dropped 1 old localization result. Angular error, verification accuracy and long-term stability remain unverified.

name: outlook
zh: 补齐方向与指向误差、他人声纹对照、实麦拾音及触摸操作验证，再拓展机器人听觉交互。
en: Next: quantify direction/pointing error; test other speakers, real-mic beamforming and touch; pursue robotic hearing.
